attributes.name: gitWatchPaths

attributes.name: stripPathDomains
attributes.description: Domains with a path whose prefix is stripped before the request reaches the container (/api/v2 arrives as /v2).

attributes.name: authRequired
attributes.description: Put the login wall in front of the app.

attributes.name: authProviders
attributes.description: Sign-in methods the wall offers: "password", "email-otp" (an emailed code), "magic-link" (an emailed link) and "oauth:" followed by a homerun_oauth_provider's name (oauth:pocket-id). Each must be enabled on the instance (the emailed ones in homerun_authentication_settings, with SMTP set up) or the API refuses it, and auth_required needs at least one. An emailed method proves only the mailbox, so it lets any Homerun account through unless auth_allowed_emails or auth_allowed_user_ids narrow it.

attributes.name: authAllowedEmails
attributes.description: Addresses, or *@domain patterns, an account's email must match to get in. Empty lets any address through.

attributes.name: authAllowedGroups
attributes.description: OIDC groups (from a linked provider) or Homerun roles, one of which an account must have to get in. Empty skips the check.

attributes.name: authAllowedUserIds
attributes.description: The only accounts let in, by id (a homerun_user or homerun_service_account id). Empty lets every account through the other rules; a service account only ever gets in when listed here.

attributes.name: previewAuthProviders
attributes.description: Sign-in methods the wall offers: "password", "email-otp" (an emailed code), "magic-link" (an emailed link) and "oauth:" followed by a homerun_oauth_provider's name (oauth:pocket-id). Each must be enabled on the instance (the emailed ones in homerun_authentication_settings, with SMTP set up) or the API refuses it, and preview_auth_required needs at least one. An emailed method proves only the mailbox, so it lets any Homerun account through unless preview_auth_allowed_emails or preview_auth_allowed_user_ids narrow it.

attributes.name: previewAuthAllowedEmails

attributes.name: previewAuthAllowedGroups
attributes.description: OIDC groups (from a linked provider) or Homerun roles, one of which an account must have to get in. Empty skips the check.

attributes.name: previewAuthAllowedUserIds

attributes.name: role
attributes.description: One of admin, developer, viewer, app-user, custom. viewer is read-only, app-user only gets through the login walls that let them in, custom holds the permissions set here. The last admin can't be demoted.

attributes.name: permissions
attributes.description: Only with role custom: the areas the user may use, each set to read or write. Areas: services, workstations, stacks, templates, cron-jobs, redirects, status-pages, storage, object-storage, registry, build-cache, git-providers, notifications, dns, remote-hosts, system, iac, users, settings. Switching to custom without it starts from the previous role's permissions.

resources.description: A person's account. It's created without a password, like Users → Add user: its owner picks one at their first sign-in, after an emailed code when SMTP is configured (without SMTP, anyone who knows the address can claim it first). Destroying it hands what the user created over to the provider's own account; the last admin and the provider's own account can't be destroyed. Service accounts are homerun_service_account.
resources.label: email

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens. It ends the redirect URI to register with the provider (the dashboard URL, then /api/v1/auth/callback/ and the name) and makes the login wall method "oauth:" followed by the name. Changing it replaces the provider.

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: Shown on the "Continue with" button. Defaults to name.

attributes.name: discoveryUrl
attributes.description: The provider's OpenID discovery document (…/.well-known/openid-configuration). Every save fetches it, and refuses one that doesn't answer with an issuer.

attributes.name: signOutOfProvider
attributes.description: Signing out of Homerun also signs out of the provider (RP-initiated logout).

attributes.name: tokenAuthMethod
attributes.description: How the client secret reaches the token endpoint: auto (HTTP Basic when the provider advertises it, else the request body), basic or post.

resources.description: An OAuth/OIDC provider people sign in with (Authentication → Providers). Applied as soon as it's saved. A login wall offers it as the method oauth: followed by its name.
resources.label: name
